Elliot: Hey all, day 1 question. Installed Homebrew on my M2 and asdf. My dotfiles assume /usr/local and my SSH/YubiKey signing isn't working in the devcontainer. Any lightweight fixes?

Casey: Welcome! For brew on Apple Silicon use /opt/homebrew. Easiest short-term: add `eval \"$($(brew --prefix)/bin/brew shellenv)\"` to your shell rc so `brew --prefix` is correct. Longer-term PR to dotfiles to use $(brew --prefix) is ideal.

Elliot: Got it. Devcontainer SSH forwarding? I can't push from inside container.

Casey: In devcontainer.json mount your SSH socket: `\"runArgs\": [\"-v\",\"${env:SSH_AUTH_SOCK}:/ssh-agent\",\"-e\",\"SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/ssh-agent\"]` and ensure `ForwardAgent yes` in ~/.ssh/config. That usually fixes agent forwarding for YubiKey.

Elliot: Node version: asdf installed 18 but the tiny frontend needs 16. How to switch without touching global?

DevEx: Run `asdf plugin-add nodejs || true; asdf install nodejs 16.20.0; asdf local nodejs 16.20.0` inside the repo. If nodejs plugin errors about gpg, `brew install gnupg` then run the plugin's import script.

Elliot: Great. Also want to avoid putting DB creds in .envrc. We use 1Password, right?

Casey: Yes, canonical secrets in 1Password. Use the CLI inside .envrc: `export DATABASE_URL=$(op item get \"redwood/dev-db\" --fields password)` and then `direnv allow`. Keeps secrets out of git.
